# Florida State Parks

> Florida State Parks provides comprehensive information for planning visits, discovering parks and trails, and experiencing outdoor recreation across Florida's state park system.

The site serves as the official gateway for visitors to Florida's network of state parks managed by the Florida Park Service. It offers practical visitor planning tools, educational resources, accommodation booking, and information about outdoor activities, conservation programs, and community engagement opportunities across the state.

## Key Topics

- Florida State Parks
- outdoor recreation
- camping
- state parks
- camping reservations
- overnight accommodations
- cabin rentals
- annual pass
- accessibility
- park activities

- pet policy
- historic sites

## Park Discovery & Planning

- [Find a Park](https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails): Directory to search and find Florida State Parks and trails
- [Plan Your Visit](https://www.floridastateparks.org/plan-your-visit): Guide to planning visits including hours, fees, camping, and accessibility
- [Experiences & Amenities](https://www.floridastateparks.org/experiences): Guide to park activities, amenities, and outdoor recreation experiences
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.floridastateparks.org/plan-your-visit/faqs): FAQs covering park rules, activities, fishing, and reservations
- [Home](https://www.floridastateparks.org): Homepage for Florida State Parks with visitor information and park activities

## Accommodations & Reservations

- [Stay the Night](https://www.floridastateparks.org/stay-night): Overnight accommodation options including camping, cabins, and RV sites
- [Fees](https://www.floridastateparks.org/fees): Complete fee schedule for park entry, camping, cabins, and annual passes
- [Florida State Parks - Passes](https://reserve.floridastateparks.org/Web/Passes/Passes.aspx): Online purchase portal for annual passes and Green Key Passes

## Visitor Policies & Guidelines

- [Access for All](https://www.floridastateparks.org/accessibility): ADA compliance and accessibility accommodations for Florida State Parks
- [Florida State Park Rules](https://www.floridastateparks.org/florida-state-park-rules): Official park rules, visitor guidelines, and prohibited activities

## Programs & Events

- [Events](https://www.floridastateparks.org/events): Calendar of events, programs, and activities across Florida parks
- [Programs](https://www.floridastateparks.org/programs): Junior Ranger and educational programs including geocaching activities
- [Educational Opportunities](https://www.floridastateparks.org/learn/education-opportunities): School programs, field trips, and LIFE environmental education initiative

## Education & Conservation

- [Learn](https://www.floridastateparks.org/learn): Educational content with staff spotlights and park information
- [Research and Collecting](https://www.floridastateparks.org/research-collecting): Scientific research permits and specimen collection guidelines

## Get Involved

- [Get Involved](https://www.floridastateparks.org/get-involved): Volunteer opportunities, careers, and ways to support Florida parks

## Optional

- [Celebration of America's 250th Anniversary](https://www.floridastateparks.org/celebration-americas-250th-anniversary): Special initiative highlighting Florida parks' colonial and revolutionary history
- [March is Florida Biking Month](https://www.floridastateparks.org/learn/march-florida-biking-month): Feature on biking trails and cycling activities in Florida parks
- [Spotlight on Pollinators](https://www.floridastateparks.org/learn/spotlight-pollinators): Educational article on native pollinators and ecosystem conservation
